name: knowthankyew-extension
description: Zero-egress, client-side browser reality engine detecting predatory subscription traps, arbitration waivers, and dark patterns in real-time

scripts.package: npm run build && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && (cd dist && zip -r ../knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}.zip .) && shasum -a 256 knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}.zip > SHA256SUMS
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && (cd dist-firefox && zip -r ../knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}-firefox.zip .) && shasum -a 256 knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}*.zip > SHA256SUMS
scripts.package:all: npm run build && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && (cd dist && zip -r ../knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}.zip .) && VITE_LOCAL_ML_ENABLED=true npx vite build && (cd dist && zip -r ../knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}-local-assist.zip .) && npm run build && shasum -a 256 knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}*.zip > SHA256SUMS
